"''Belsavis. Next.|A [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|shoretrooper]] processes Tuck Hybecks|}} '''Tuck Hybecks''' was a [[human]] from the [[planet]] [[Galdi]]. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|108}} they were charged in [[Niamos Courthouse|court]] by the [[Galactic Empire]] on the planet [[Niamos]]. Afterwards, the individual joined a queue of convicts being led to [[Imperial Troop Transport|Imperial transports]], which would take them to [[Prison|penal]] facilities. A [[Unidentified shoretrooper (Niamos)|shoretrooper]] processing the queue asked for Hybecks' name and [[Homeworld|home planet]]. After Hybecks answered accordingly, they were directed to a [[transport]] about to take them to [[Belsavis]], a celestial body in the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim's]] [[Senex-Juvex]] [[sector]]s,[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] where they would serve their sentence. The human had [[Color|light]] skin and black [[hair]], sporting a tea green jacket with dark features on the front. ==Behind the scenes== Portrayed by an uncredited actor, Tuck Hybecks appeared in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," the eighth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', released on [[October 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like.
